DAVID CHEN
david.chen@email.com | +1 (555) 017-4569 | Austin, TX | linkedin.com
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Performance-driven Backend Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience specializing in Java application development, microservices architecture, and production-level systems design. Expert in building low-latency, highly scalable RESTful APIs within the Spring Ecosystem. Proficient in optimizing database communication layers, enforcing strict object-oriented design principles, and deploying containerized applications through automated pipelines.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Core Engineering: Java (8/11/17), Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Data Structures, Algorithms, Multi-threading.
Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security (OAuth2), Spring Data JPA, Hibernate ORM.
Databases & Tools: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Docker, Git, Maven, Gradle.
Testing & CI/CD: JUnit 5, Mockito, Jenkins.
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Software Engineer (Java) | CoreSystem Technologies | 2024 – Present
Designed and engineered 12+ decoupled, low-latency microservices using Java 17 and Spring Boot, increasing backend system throughput by 35%.
Developed secure, optimized RESTful APIs and integrated Hibernate ORM for relational mapping, resolving query latency bottlenecks in PostgreSQL by 25%.
Implemented enterprise-grade authentication and authorization protocols utilizing Spring Security and OAuth2 across all active API gateways.
Containerized legacy backend monolithic applications using Docker, establishing automated deployment scripts within a continuous integration pipeline.
Associate Java Developer | Ironclad Software Labs | 2022 – 2024
Wrote clean, maintainable backend source code in Java 11 following SOLID design principles and robust object-oriented patterns.
Constructed extensive unit and integration testing suites utilizing JUnit and Mockito frameworks, maintaining a strict minimum of 92% test coverage.
Collaborated closely with system architects to debug, patch, and optimize multi-threaded data processing applications.
EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | University of Texas at Austin
